task.title: Diagnose: Troubleshoot database and storage issues
task.shortdesc: Diese Prozedur bewahrt Evidence, schützt Benutzerdaten und trennt Operator Action von Product Defect. Diagnose local SQLite, storage path, backup, and profile visibility issues without editing database rows directly.

prereq.p: Diese Prozedur bewahrt Evidence, schützt Benutzerdaten und trennt Operator Action von Product Defect. Use this procedure when profiles disappear, writes fail, migration evidence is unclear, backup checksums do not match, or BPM_DATABASE_URL points to an unexpected location.

context.p: Diese Prozedur bewahrt Evidence, schützt Benutzerdaten und trennt Operator Action von Product Defect. Current source deployment uses local storage such as sqlite+aiosqlite:///./data/bpm.db and repository-owned files under data/, schema cache paths, and documentation site paths. There is no managed backup or restore orchestration in BPM 0.9.0.

step.cmd: Diagnose 1: Confirm the active database URL and working directory.

info.p: Diese Prozedur bewahrt Evidence, schützt Benutzerdaten und trennt Operator Action von Product Defect. Record BPM_DATABASE_URL, current directory, source revision, and whether the process runs from Linux filesystem or /mnt/c. Do not assume two shells point at the same data/bpm.db.

step.cmd: Diagnose 2: Check migration and profile API evidence before opening storage files.

info.p: Diese Prozedur bewahrt Evidence, schützt Benutzerdaten und trennt Operator Action von Product Defect. Focused rerun: alembic upgrade head, then curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/profiles?limit=50. If the API returns expected profiles, the symptom may be filter, lifecycle, or browser state.

step.cmd: Diagnose 3: Verify backup evidence before destructive recovery.

info.p: Diese Prozedur bewahrt Evidence, schützt Benutzerdaten und trennt Operator Action von Product Defect. Check mkdir -p backups, cp data/bpm.db backups/bpm-pre-update.db, and sha256sum backups/bpm-pre-update.db records. Keep exports of critical policies.json profiles as separate evidence.

step.cmd: Diagnose 4: Avoid direct database row edits.

info.p: Diese Prozedur bewahrt Evidence, schützt Benutzerdaten und trennt Operator Action von Product Defect. Do not edit SQLite rows, generated artifacts, or schema cache files as routine recovery. Use documented profile archive, restore, import, export, or update-from-source procedures instead.

step.cmd: Diagnose 5: Escalate with storage evidence when recovery is unsafe.

info.p: Diese Prozedur bewahrt Evidence, schützt Benutzerdaten und trennt Operator Action von Product Defect. Include database URL, file path, checksum, migration command, API response, and backup/export evidence.
info.note: If no verified pre-failure backup exists, stop before deleting or replacing data/bpm.db; BPM does not provide point-in-time recovery.

result.p: Der Operator erhält eine klassifizierte Diagnose, schützt user data und kennt den nächsten smallest rerun. The operator has a storage diagnosis that preserves user data and separates database state from UI or filter symptoms.

postreq.p: Nach der Behebung zum passenden Administrator/DevOps workflow zurückkehren und nur die betroffenen checks wiederholen. After storage is stable, rerun health/readiness and the smallest affected API workflow.
